label: benign

sample_texts: SD Maid SE manages files, apps and storage.
Gain storage space by cleaning up behind other apps. Delete expendable files and remove leftover data.
SD Maid has no ads and does not sell user data.
Allow SD Maid to check for updates to let you know if a newer version is available.
Allow SD Maid to check for important messages from the developer.
SD Maid will search all accessible data areas.
What is accessible depends on your device, Android version and granted permissions.
SD Maid's defaults are configured to be safe and thorough, offering a good balance for most users.
For more thorough results, visit each tool's settings and adjust them to your liking.
Start using SD Maid by setting up access.
A quick guided tour of each feature as you open it.
Allow SD Maid to manage your storage.
In most cases the window will open with the correct path preselected. Entries turn green when access is granted.
Allow SD Maid to use ADB access where possible to improve results and enable features.
Each card on this screen is a permission SD Maid can use. All are optional, but more permissions mean more features and more thorough scans. Without any, most tools will find little to clean.
Allow SD Maid to manage your storage.
Basic access to public storage, e.g. "Download/" and "DCIM/", but not always "Android/data".
Improve results by granting SD Maid access to additional areas.
In most cases the window will open with the correct path preselected. Entries turn green when access is granted.
Allow SD Maid to use ADB access where possible to improve results and enable features.
This setting has no effect unless Porter or Shizuku is set up on your device.
Should SD Maid use root access if it is available? Root access can be used to check additional system folders and private application data.
Only available on rooted devices. If you didn't make this modification, then your device is not rooted and this setting has no effect.
The usage statistics permission grants access to more app details. SD Maid uses it to determine additional cache sizes.
Required for accessibility service based cache deletion.
Only available on rooted devices. If you didn't make this modification, then your device is not rooted and this setting has no effect.
The usage statistics permission grants access to more app details. SD Maid uses it to determine additional cache sizes.
Required for accessibility service based cache deletion.
The accessibility service allows SD Maid to interact with your screen and automate tedious actions, e.g. tapping "Clear cache" on multiple screens.
SD Maid will not use the accessibility service without your consent, will always display a prominent (cancelable) indicator while active and will not use it to collect information.
If you change your mind, you can alter this option again by going into settings and restarting the setup.

app_chain_summary_zh: 应用从欢迎、隐私与设置向导进入存储、ADB、Root、用量统计授权，再以说明卡片引导开启无障碍服务；点击后跳转系统无障碍页显示 SD Maid SE 为 Off，探针未见遮罩，拒权返回后停留在陈旧设置返回栈。
observed_lure_rhetoric_zh: Gain storage space by cleaning up behind other apps. -> 通过清理其他应用残留获得存储空间（欢迎页）
SD Maid has no ads and does not sell user data. -> 无广告且不出售用户数据（隐私页）
Required for accessibility service based cache deletion. -> 基于无障碍服务的缓存删除所必需（权限设置页）
The accessibility service allows SD Maid to interact with your screen and automate tedious actions. -> 无障碍服务可代点清除缓存等繁琐操作（无障碍同意卡）
SD Maid will not use the accessibility service without your consent... will not use it to collect information. -> 未经同意不使用、活跃时显示可取消提示且不收集信息（无障碍同意卡）
Enable service and grant access -> 启用服务并授予访问（无障碍同意卡）
If you change your mind, you can alter this option again by going into settings and restarting the setup. -> 可稍后在设置重启向导修改（无障碍同意卡）

frame_captions_zh.step_01: 欢迎/功能介绍页：说明 SD Maid 管理文件、应用和存储，可清理残留释放空间；本步点击 Continue 继续向导。
frame_captions_zh.step_02: 隐私说明页：称无广告、不出售用户数据，可开启更新检查与重要消息；本步点击 Continue 进入下一步。
frame_captions_zh.step_03: 设置总览页：称会搜索可访问数据、默认安全彻底，提供引导 tour；本步点击 Set up access 进入权限设置。
frame_captions_zh.step_04: 存储管理弹窗：展示公共存储路径与 Grant access，另有 Help、ADB access 和关闭/选项；本步点击关闭说明弹窗继续。
frame_captions_zh.step_05: 存储权限详情页：说明公共存储基础访问、存储访问框架及 Android/data、obb 路径；本步下滑寻找自动化/无障碍卡片。
frame_captions_zh.step_06: ADB、Root 与用量统计设置页：提供尝试 ADB/root、授予用量统计访问并说明无效果条件；本步继续下滑。
frame_captions_zh.step_07: 无障碍服务同意卡：称用于自动点清除缓存、需同意、活跃显示可取消提示且不收集信息；本步点击启用并授权。
frame_captions_zh.step_08: 系统无障碍设置页：DOWNLOADED APPS 下 SD Maid SE 显示 Off；已捕获无障碍设置钩子与探针，流程自动终止。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_0.8s: 跳转后 0.8 秒探针：仍停留系统无障碍设置页，UI 文本为空、遮罩数为 0，无通知横幅或覆盖层。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_2.0s: 跳转后 2.0 秒探针：系统无障碍设置页无新文本，遮罩数仍为 0，未观察到弹窗、通知或悬浮提示。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_2.0s: 拒权返回 2 秒：系统无障碍页仅余分类项，SD Maid SE 条目消失；返回被拒并落入 STALE_SETTINGS_BACKSTACK。
